faqs.question: How do I join the police department or another department?
faqs.answer:
To join the **Alabama Police Department (APD)** or another department, submit an application in <#1360792977181769768>.

• **Requirements:** Listed inside each department application in <#1360792977181769768>.
• **Results:** Once submitted, wait for results to be posted in <#1360793057930252539>.
• **Status:** Do not DM department leadership asking to check your application.

faqs.question: What are the requirements to join a department?
faqs.answer: Requirements are listed on each department's own application in the **Department Applications** channel. In general you must submit the correct application and wait for approval, meet the department's listed requirements, remain active, act professionally, and complete the application truthfully. Acceptance is not guaranteed; leadership decides based on eligibility, application quality, activity, professionalism, and department needs.

faqs.question: How do I request a role?
faqs.answer: Use the role-request process if you have passed an application or been approved for a position. Format: **Username**, **Role(s) Requested**, **Reason**, and **Proof** (preferably a screenshot or image). Request all roles you are eligible for, including required divider roles, and only request roles applicable to your current position or rank. Request status: **Red** = denied or requirements not met, **Green** = roles successfully assigned.

faqs.question: How do I join the server? What is the server code?
faqs.answer: Open **Emergency Response: Alabama** on Roblox, go to **Servers**, select **Join Server**, and enter the server code `ALABAM`. Please confirm the code is still current before relying on it, as it can change.

faqs.question: How do I apply for staff? What are the staff requirements?
faqs.answer: Staff recruitment is handled through the official staff application panel in the **Staff Applications** channel. Do not ping staff for your application status. In-Game Staff patrol the ER:LC private server, enforce roleplay rules, answer moderation calls, and monitor safe zones. Requirements: at least **14 years old**, active each week in the ER:LC server or Discord, and a working microphone plus clip-recording software. **AI-generated application answers are not allowed** — answers must be written by you in your own words.

faqs.question: How do I set up CAD and Radio?
faqs.answer: Department members use **Sonoran Radio** and **Sonoran CAD** during departmental operations. All members receive standard CAD features; extra permissions depend on department, rank, and responsibilities. Department officers must display an approved callsign and join the active Alabama CAD and Radio during patrols. If you are having CAD or radio issues, open a support ticket and staff will help.

faqs.question: How do I get department access / CAD access?
faqs.answer: Department access is not automatic. You must apply, be accepted, complete required training, and receive your departmental information. After acceptance, the person accepting your application provides the relevant information, which may include a Sonoran CAD permission key, department link, whitelisted group link, Sonoran Radio Community ID, and other instructions. To obtain Civilian CAD access, verify in the CAD channel. Staff cannot give out permission keys or restricted department information to unauthorized users.

faqs.question: When is the next patrol or session?
faqs.answer: Patrol schedules, session votes, and server start times are posted in the **Sessions** channel. Please check there for the latest times.

faqs.question: How much do departments get paid?
faqs.answer: The server material states that all departments receive **$25,000** with every payment. Beyond that, staff cannot confirm payment frequency or other financial rules — for anything more specific, please open a ticket so staff can review it.

faqs.question: Do I need a separate department character?
faqs.answer: Yes. Department members must have a regular character for civilian/general roleplay and a separate departmental character for their selected department.

faqs.question: I want to advertise or partner with the server.
faqs.answer: Partnership, mutual advertising, paid promotions, and staff transfers are handled in the **Partnership** ticket category. Please open a Partnership ticket so the right team can review your request. Staff will confirm acceptance and any pricing details with you — those are not set here.

faqs.question: I want to report a staff member.
faqs.answer: Thank you for reaching out. Internal Affairs handles staff reports and community concerns. Please share the details of your report — who was involved, what happened, when, and any evidence (screenshots, clips). A member of our staff team will review it. Please note: we do not decide whether allegations are true here, and we keep these reports confidential. An authorized staff member will take it from here.

faqs.question: I have a community concern.
faqs.answer: Internal Affairs is the right place for community concerns. Please describe the concern in detail so an authorized staff member can review it. We stay neutral and professional and will not share private staff discussions. A staff member will follow up with you.

faqs.question: I need High Rank or executive help.
faqs.answer: This ticket is for executive and administrative matters, IA+ reports, and administrative management. Please describe what you need so an authorized high-ranking staff member can review it. Decisions that require IA+ or executive authority must be made by an authorized staff member — I can't approve or decide those here. A staff member will take it from here.

faqs.question: I want to report something about a department.
faqs.answer: Department Reports are handled by authorized department staff. Please describe what happened, which department is involved, when, and any evidence. If the report involves staff misconduct, it may be escalated to Internal Affairs or High Rank Support per our procedures. An authorized staff member will review it.

learned.question: How do I request my roles after passing?
learned.answer:
To request your roles after passing your application, please follow these steps:

1. Go to the **role-request** channel.
2. Use the following format for your request:
   - **Username**
   - **Role(s) Requested**
   - **Reason**
   - **Proof** (preferably a screenshot or image of your application approval).
3. Make sure to request all roles you are eligible for, including any required divider roles.

Once submitted, your request will be reviewed, and you will receive a status update: **Red** means denied, and **Green** means approved. If you have any questions, feel free to ask!
